info.title: Brai private Silero Russian TTS runner
info.description: Private JSON-RPC 2.0 over UTF-8 stdin/stdout lines. A checksum-verified local Silero package runs on CPU with four threads; eugene is the only accepted voice. No network listener or model downloader. Closed named parameters and envelope; unknown fields are rejected.

methods.name: health
methods.summary: Confirm that the pinned model with voice eugene is loaded.

methods.name: synthesize
methods.summary: Synthesize Russian text to mono 48 kHz OggOpus at 32 kbit/s.

x-transport.type: UTF-8 JSON text lines over child-process stdin/stdout
x-transport.request: Closed JSON-RPC 2.0 object or nonempty batch; params is an object or absent; id is a string, finite number or null.
x-transport.response: One result/error line; request id is echoed for recognized requests.
x-transport.notification: Valid notifications execute without a response, including failed notifications.
x-transport.batch: Sequential execution; one response array in request order, omitting notifications; an all-notification batch emits nothing.
x-transport.diagnostics: Model and ffmpeg output is discarded; startup failure emits one fixed safe stderr message. stdout contains only RPC responses.
x-transport.offline: Local checksum-verified package only; ffmpeg accepts only local file protocol and WAV demuxer.

x-jsonrpc-errors.-32700: Parse error; invalid UTF-8/JSON, duplicate object keys, non-JSON constants or line beyond limit; id null.
x-jsonrpc-errors.-32600: Invalid Request; invalid or non-closed envelope, invalid id or empty batch; id null.
x-jsonrpc-errors.-32601: Method not found; original id preserved.
x-jsonrpc-errors.-32603: Internal error; model, filesystem, encoding, timeout and output-limit failures; no details.

x-resource-lifecycle.owner: Local AI parent owns the private directory and entire process group; no unload or cancel RPC.
x-resource-lifecycle.output: synthesize removes the previous audio.ogg, uses a per-request temporary directory, then atomically replaces outputDirectory/audio.ogg. Temporary files are removed on success or failure. Output survives until next accepted synthesis or parent cleanup after confirmed process-group exit.
x-resource-lifecycle.deadline: Parent bounds the full operation at 180 seconds and cancels by stopping the entire process group. RPC timeout alone does not confirm exit.
x-resource-lifecycle.retry: No automatic retries or id deduplication; each invocation, including a notification, synthesizes again. Multiple syntheses in a batch overwrite the same output path.
